title: t8y2/dbx
claim: t8y2/dbx — 20 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 70+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB,
why_good: A 20MB cross-platform client for 70+ databases, extremely active (150 contributors, 1,438 commits/30d) — a lean TablePlus/DBeaver challenger people clearly use.
value: DB clients monetize as a paid pro/team tier (TablePlus and DBeaver both do): sync, collaboration, enterprise SSO on top of the free client.
risk: Crowded (DBeaver / TablePlus / DataGrip); needs a sharp wedge — size/speed — to pull paying users off incumbents.
